dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Which ear is bothering you, and when did the problem first start?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: My right ear has been painful for about two days. It started as mild discomfort, but today the pain feels stronger.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had a fever, any fluid or discharge from the ear, or any change in your hearing?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No fever and no discharge, but sounds seem quieter in my right ear than in my left.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed any ringing, buzzing, or dizziness?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have noticed a faint ringing sound in the right ear a few times, but I have not felt dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you recently have a cold, sore throat, or another respiratory infection?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I had a mild cold last week with a blocked nose, but most of those symptoms have improved.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you been swimming recently or put anything inside the ear to clean it?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No swimming, and I have not put anything inside the ear.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: All right. I will examine the ear canal and eardrum and check for infection, inflammation, or fluid behind the eardrum.
